spark_open.description: The creature is a quadrupedal, dome-bodied reptile shown in right-facing side view standing on sparse dry ground. Its main body is a large domed shell whose dorsal surface is completely covered by a thick coat of long, shaggy brown fur, with only the lower side margins of the shell exposed. It has a thick, scaly neck extending forward to a blunt-beaked, scaly head, four stout columnar scaly legs with clawed feet supporting the body, and a short, pointed scaly tail protruding at the rear beneath the fur and shell margin. The exposed skin on the head, neck, legs and tail is covered in small polygonal scales, with larger pointed tubercles on the forelimbs.

meta_spark.description: A stocky four-legged reptile with the body form of a large land tortoise is shown in right-side profile standing on patchy dry ground with sparse grass. Its domed shell is almost entirely covered by a thick mantle of long shaggy brown fur, with only the lower rim of tan and brown scutes visible along the sides and rear. The exposed head, thick neck, four massive columnar legs, and short pointed tail are covered in detailed tan-brown reptilian scales, the front legs bearing larger conical spurs. The head is large with a beaked snout and small dark eye, held forward on the extended neck. The feet are broad with short blunt claws.

spark_open.description: A stout, low-slung quadrupedal creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of dry, sandy ground with sparse tufts of grass. It has the overall build of a large tortoise with a high, domed shell, a short thick neck, a blunt reptilian head, four massive columnar legs, and a short pointed tail. The dorsal and lateral surfaces of the shell are densely covered with long, shaggy, coarse brown fur that hangs over the shell rim like a coat, while the exposed rim of the shell shows light tan to brown scutes with concentric growth lines. The head, neck, legs, and tail are covered in dry, polygonal reptilian scales in tan and brown tones, and the coloration overall is muted earthy browns and tans on an off-white background.

meta_spark.description: A large four-legged reptile with the body of a land tortoise shown in side view facing right, standing on patchy dirt with sparse grass. It has a domed shell with a visible rim of pale tan and brown scutes, but the top of the shell is completely covered by a thick coat of long shaggy brown fur that hangs over the sides and over the hindquarters. The head, thick neck, four stout columnar legs, and short tapering tail are covered in tan-brown scaly reptilian skin, with large pointed scales on the front legs and short blunt claws on the feet.
